checks.name: Initial sample: only choice is open; no production runtime or login
Missing choice answers block submission; UI selections survive reload
Choice 4/5 unlocks sorting immediately and explains the selected wrong option
Five sentences are assembled by clicking tokens; 5/5 unlocks translation and tokens stay visible
Translation rejects empty/zero-width-only answers, stores raw multiline text, and has no feedback grades
Receipt contains all five submitted originals and no machine grade; desktop result is reviewable
Reload retains first scores and raw submitted translation
Choice redo scores 0/5 while first remains 4/5 and later groups stay open
An unsubmitted translation redo keeps its previous receipt accessible and independent
Student HTML is displayed as literal text in fields and the submitted receipt
Downloaded backup restores through visible UI in a fresh browser context; invalid import preserves it
Synthetic legacy-v2 backup migrates through the UI; old translation is archived, never completed
Built offline HTML starts independently and preserves one UI answer on reload

limitations: Chromium software test in an isolated CI browser; no production site or user session.
Viewport checks are not physical-phone or Safari compatibility certification.
Unicode text entry and preservation are tested; operating-system IME keyboards are not emulated.
